errors.evidence: The categories on the vertical axis are arranged in reverse chronological order, from the most recent period (2013-2018) at the top to the oldest (1990-1995) at the bottom. Stating there is no logical sequence is incorrect.
The bar for the period 2013-2018 clearly ends below the 30% mark, at approximately 29%. The description's claim of 'a little over 30%' is factually incorrect.
The bar for the period 1996-2001 corresponds to a value of approximately 18%. The stated value of 'около 19%' is an overestimation.
The bar for the period 2008-2012 corresponds to a value of approximately 21%. The stated value of 'около 22%' is an overestimation.
